definitions.explanation: The side of an object or surface that faces downward or is positioned below another part.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{下側|したがわ}を{見|み}て。
examples.english: Look at the underside of the box.

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}の{下側|したがわ}にほこりが{溜|た}まっていた。
examples.english: Dust had accumulated on the underside of the shelf.

examples.japanese: {橋|はし}の{下側|したがわ}に{亀裂|きれつ}が{入|はい}っていないか{定期|ていき}{的|てき}に{点検|てんけん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It is necessary to regularly inspect the underside of the bridge for cracks.

notes:
Refers to the lower surface or the part underneath something. Formed from {下|した} (below) and {側|がわ} (side). Used when specifying which side of an object you mean, often in contexts involving inspection, cleaning, or spatial description.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {机|つくえ}の{下側|したがわ}: underside of a desk
- {車|くるま}の{下側|したがわ}: underside of a car
- {下側|したがわ}から{見|み}る: to look from below
- {下側|したがわ}に{貼|は}る: to stick on the underside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上側|うわがわ}: upper side — the opposite direction
- {裏側|うらがわ}: back side, reverse — refers to the hidden face rather than specifically the lower one
- {底|そこ}: bottom — the very lowest surface, not a "side"
